summary: For VMware vSphere, build the Edge Manager bootc image with cloud-init late binding and open-vm-tools (vmtoolsd enabled), then run bootc-image-builder to produce a vmdk disk image instead of an iso.
questions: How do I build an Edge Manager image for VMware vSphere?
How do I create a vmdk disk image with bootc-image-builder?
Which guest tools does a vSphere edge image need?
